notes.title: Answering your questions
notes.content: [h3][b]What's up, drivers![/b][/h3][p]From now on, we’ll be answering the most frequently asked questions in posts like this one.[/p][h3][b]When does the game come out?[/b][/h3][p]We're planning to launch in early access by the end of this year, with the full release of the game expected in 2026![/p][h3][b]Will the damage model be punishing?[/b] [/h3][p]The damage model is designed to be to challenge the player. Car repair is one of your constant expenses. However, in online rooms, it can be adjusted or made free to avoid excessive grind. Additionally, tires are considered a consumable resource and must be purchased.[/p][h3][b]Will there be different materials for body kits?[/b] [/h3][p]Yes, the implementation of different materials for body kits is a planned. However, this functionality will not be available at the start of Early Access.[/p][h3][b]Will [i]Drift Racing Online 2[/i] be released on consoles?[/b] [/h3][p]А console release is planned, but not before the second half of 2026.[/p][h3][b]Will Time Attack be available?[/b] [/h3][p]Time Attack will be one of the game modes, but not available immediately. Players will be able to tune their cars for grip racing, not limited to drift only.[/p][h3][b]When can we expect some news about the game?[/b][/h3][p]This month, we'll start actively sharing news about the project. Add the game to your wishlist and follow us on social media so you don't miss a thing.[/p]
